$comment: Machine-readable inventory of what this project has built, held, and not yet started. Validated by `python3 scripts/harness.py --only manifest`: every path must exist, every verb must be dispatchable, every status must be in the enum, and every id must be unique. A stale entry fails the gate rather than quietly misleading the next reader.

stages.name: Instrumentation and goldens
stages.gate: none - no behaviour change by design
stages.summary: Measurement before change. budget report, golden reference set, bench scorer, baseline recorded. SKILL.md and workflows/ left byte-identical deliberately.

stages.name: Cost wins that cannot touch quality
stages.summary: Model/effort tiering, MCP preflight, audit.py verbs replacing inline heredocs, dispatch briefs as files, return contracts. First stage to edit the shipped skill; the installer fix was a hard dependency of the verbs.

stages.name: Structural change
stages.gate: tplink re-run twice - cost must fall, recall >= 9/19
stages.summary: audit_core extracted (db, extract, annotations, coverage, sweep, budget), R1 and R3 landed, vendored into the skill with phase semantics unchanged.

stages.name: Quality additions
stages.gate: tplink re-run twice - cost must fall, recall >= 9/19; tiering half measured separately on precision
stages.summary: Five mechanisms, each answering a named cause of a missed CRITICAL in the tplink post-mortem: pivot rule, sweep-on-confirm, coverage denominator, identity discipline, chain composition. The Sonnet tiering half is held - see feature sonnet-tiering.

stages.name: Measurement hardening and parked defects
stages.gate: none - no audit run, no change to audit output
stages.summary: Deterministic leading indicators (parent spec 6.1), severity agreement and coverage in bench, an advisory severity re-rating report, and the four defects Stages 0 and 1 parked. Ships while the benchmark gates are deferred on cost, because nothing in it changes what an audit records.

stages.name: qualify - the hard GO/NO-GO gate
stages.gate: none - no audit run; scores an existing CSV
stages.summary: The first vertical slice of firmware-audit. Scores one vendor|model against the hunting plan's three filters and refuses to start a pipeline on a target that cannot pay. Deterministic work against _intel/target-scores.csv, verifiable at zero audit cost.

stages.name: Core hardening - coverage gate and mutation harness
stages.summary: Two instruments, no audit behaviour change. A sys.monitoring coverage gate with an allowlist (115 unexecuted of 2,392 statements to 0) and an opt-in mutation harness (1068 mutants, 66.3% killed) that finds tests which execute a line while asserting nothing about it. Added tests and tooling only; claims no movement in recall or precision.

stages.name: acquire and triage - firmware provenance and inventory
stages.gate: none - no audit run; unit, corpus consistency, and existing read-only benchmark checks
stages.summary: The second vertical slice of firmware-audit. Records two firmware-image roles, inventories an already-carved rootfs, reads bounded ELF facts, discovers evidenced boot services, and ships the triage agent brief. It does not fetch, carve, diff, infer open ports, or create the separate firmware-audit skill tree.

stages.name: diff - image-scoped firmware comparison and patch analysis brief
stages.gate: none - no audit run; full harness, read-only corpus consistency, and existing benchmark scoring
stages.summary: Migrates firmware facts to image-scoped keys, hashes regular-file manifests, compares acquired target/reference pairs deterministically, persists complete changed-path results with content-addressed JSON, and ships the semantic patch-analysis brief. Target-only inventory mirroring protects coverage; general surface mapping remains Stage 4d.

stages.name: surface - evidence-backed firmware dispatch mapping and completion
stages.gate: none - no audit run; focused regressions, full harness, and existing read-only benchmark scoring
stages.summary: Merged into local main at 6eba6d6 (last implementation b14b4fb), not pushed. Verifies the live target root, prepares deterministic full-manifest batches, imports strict agent results atomically, records state and settling questions, and gates complete coverage with canonical evidence for every batch. Database inventory and surface coverage use deterministic image-qualified unit keys while artifacts and surface-facing paths stay raw. Overlapping targets are isolated without schema changes; ambiguous old raw surface coverage is refused/preserved. Stage 4e consumes its verified generation; the surface gate retains its orphan-candidate scan scaling limitation.

stages.name: hunt - evidence-bound two-lane firmware candidate analysis
stages.gate: make all: 8/8 gates; 2,925 tests; 0/4,946 uncovered statements; merged locally at 8119af1, not pushed
stages.summary: Merged into local main at 8119af1, not pushed. Independent L-sink and L-dark worklists cover the complete selected target denominator and bind candidates to current surface evidence. Stage 4f firmware fpcheck is in progress: its five-table schema foundation, row contracts, verified completed-hunt snapshot, deterministic review preparation and strict result parsing/validation are implemented; Task 6 atomic batch import is next.

stages.name: firmware-audit
stages.gate: tplink >= 12/19 at <= $45, and the asus golden must also pass
stages.summary: Full firmware phase set from spec section 4, plus the monorepo restructure. Built as vertical slices: qualify shipped as stage4a, acquire plus triage as stage4b, diff as stage4c, surface as stage4d, and hunt merged into local main at 8119af1 as stage4e, not pushed. Stage 4f firmware fpcheck is in progress with its five-table schema foundation, verified completed-hunt snapshot, deterministic review preparation and strict result parsing/validation implemented; Task 6 atomic batch import is next. The required asus golden is still missing; the monorepo/submodule decision and separate skill tree remain open.

stages.name: Alignment
stages.summary: Backport the shared core to grey-audit and build its Stage 2/3 on the same spine.

features.name: Session economics report
features.notes: Parses a Claude Code JSONL session into epochs, prefix, growth and attribution. Two measurement defects were found and fixed after the first baseline; see docs/baselines/2026-10-05-tplink-baseline.md.

features.name: Golden reference scoring
features.notes: Recall, cost per match and (since Stage 3) precision. matches.json and rejections.json are human adjudications and are never written by a tool.

features.name: Project-scoped MCP preflight (R4)
features.notes: Writes a config naming only the servers a run needs, to cut the MCP share of the context prefix. Its output has never reached a client that actually connected a real MCP server - see open_items.

features.name: Dispatch briefs as files (R6)
features.notes: A brief is rendered to a file and its path passed to the subagent, rather than pasted into the prompt.

features.name: Installer copies audit.py and audit_core
features.notes: A hard dependency of R5, not an independent item: install.sh originally copied only prose, so the first workflow to invoke audit.py broke every installed copy. __SKILL_DIR__ is sed-substituted per client so each copy calls its own.

features.name: Model and reasoning-effort tiering
features.notes: The measured 18.0% thinking term. Mechanical work only - the quality-risking half is held, see sonnet-tiering.

features.name: Subagent return contracts (R2)
features.notes: Everything stays in SQL and the artifact; widen the query, never the return.

features.name: Validated, bounded audit.db access
features.notes: TABLE_SPECS is the single contract: columns, required columns and validators. db.py is the only writer. put(replace=True) merges rather than replaces - a bare INSERT OR REPLACE dropped columns a different workflow step writes.

features.name: Extract once, fan out without a cap (R1)
features.notes: The orchestrator never holds raw material. Carries a batch-boundary one-writer assertion.

features.name: Context ceiling with checkpoint-restart (R3)
features.notes: Projection plus an external check, so a run survives its own length.

features.name: Append-only annotation journal
features.notes: Comprehension that survives a restart. Bounded index; tolerant of a CRLF-terminated line.

features.name: Bounded corpus sweep for a confirmed pattern
features.notes: ROOT_ONLY_SKIP_DIRS holds 'reports' and is applied only at the walk root - skipping it at any depth hid a real strcpy in src/reports/export.c.

features.name: Shipped skill linted against the economics contract
features.notes: The only automated check on prose that is not a content assertion. Pins the retired queries and the __SKILL_DIR__ sentinel.

features.name: Three independent internal consistency checks
features.notes: Verbs vs parser, TABLE_SPECS vs schema.sql, MIGRATIONS vs the frozen pre-Stage-3 baseline. Each compares two structures built independently - a tool's output is only trustworthy against something it did not produce.

features.name: In-place column migration
features.notes: SQLite has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS and CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS is a no-op on an existing table, so editing schema.sql repairs nothing on a database that already exists. connect() refuses an unmigrated database; selftest proves the loop against a frozen baseline.

features.name: A FALSE_POSITIVE must say what refuted it
features.notes: And what that refutation enables. A dismissal that leaves no trail loses the observation underneath it. All failure checks precede the first write.

features.name: An unswept registered pattern is a reportable gap
features.notes: A confirmed bug becomes a registered pattern; sweep.record marks it swept and refuses a truncated result. One instance of a bug class is rarely the only one.

features.name: Coverage denominator with a phase-exit gate
features.notes: Analyzed over inventoried, with a reason for every gap. The gate must be --phase scoped; unscoped it reported PASS/100% on a run whose audited phase never opened the only unit. It gates but does not block.

features.name: An asserted identity needs non-circular evidence
features.notes: Evidence that is not the component's own filename, at least MIN_EVIDENCE_CHARS long, with novel tokens after text.NOISE_WORDS filtering. 'the file is named km0_boot_0C000020.elf' is the circular reasoning this rejects.

features.name: Cross-group exploit chain proposal
features.notes: Measured on the real corpus for the first time and found unusable as designed - 100 candidates capped, 33 of 45 findings never examined as enablers and nothing saying so. Retuned to 24 candidates uncapped, all 45 examined, with unexamined findings reported.

features.name: Precision scored alongside recall
features.notes: The 'before' half of the held tiering gate. Currently 39/40 against 47.4% recall - the signature of an FP-check that is not filtering much, which is why the output carries its caveat on the same screen as the figure.

features.name: Sonnet downgrade for feature mapping and FP-check
features.notes: Spec-mandated, deliberately not applied: no precision baseline exists on the current configuration, so there is no 'before' to measure against. The gate document carries the exact five-file diff; applying it later is transcription. Two guard tests keep it from being applied by accident.

features.name: Eight-gate verification harness
features.notes: tests, selftest, lint, eol, manifest, install, bench. Five of the seven were previously run by hand from memory in an order nobody wrote down; eol and manifest were not checked by anything at all. The install gate refuses to run if its sandbox HOME resolves to the real one and asserts afterwards that all four real destinations' mtimes did not move.

features.name: Enforced CRLF/LF manifest
features.notes: Nothing previously pinned which files carry CRLF. test_install.py checks only that whatever shipped with CRLF keeps it through an install, which cannot notice a file that lost its CRLF before the install ran.

features.name: Progress, handoff, architecture and feature inventory
features.notes: Written so another agent can resume without reading a compacted transcript.

features.name: firmware-audit sibling skill
features.notes: Spec section 4: qualify as a hard gate, diff before hunt, two non-transferable hunt lanes, decide replacing verify, emulation as a capability rather than a phase.

features.name: Monorepo restructure
features.notes: Spec section 3.1. Submodule plus sync.sh is the fallback if grey-audit must keep its separate history.

features.name: Cross-target pattern library
features.notes: Spec section 3.5.2. Recorded as a deliberate omission from Stage 3; destination Stage 4.

features.name: Backport the core to grey-audit
features.notes: Spec section 7, Stage 5. Build grey-audit's Stage 2/3 - hunt, fpcheck, verify, report, Lanes B/C/D - on the shared spine.

features.name: Deterministic leading indicators
features.notes: Coverage percentage, surfaces opened, sweep hit counts and not_audited rows, with dated JSON snapshots under docs/indicators/ and a --compare that names what moved. The between-milestone substitute the parent spec 6.1 names and nobody built. Three of the four have no data in any existing audit.db, so they ship verified against fixtures.

features.name: Severity agreement scoring in bench
features.notes: Additive: recall keeps its meaning so 9/19 and the >=12/19 target stay valid, with severity-weighted recall emitted alongside. Measurable today for free against the stored baseline; the expected result is four under-rated matches with REF-17 the worst delta.

features.name: Coverage scoring in bench
features.notes: Parent spec 6.1 defines bench as scoring recall, precision, coverage and cost per finding. It scores three of the four.

features.name: Advisory severity re-rating report
features.notes: Reports findings whose recorded severity disagrees with their own cited evidence, and stores nothing. Its own verb rather than part of bench because it needs no golden set, so it works on every real client audit rather than only the one corpus with a reference set.

features.name: absent is not zero, in every new reader
features.notes: A pre-Stage-2 database has no cba_coverage table; reporting 0% claims total failure where the truth is no data. Every reader added in Stage 3b distinguishes a value, absent (no table) and empty (table, no rows). Same shape as the unscoped coverage gate that reported PASS/100% on a run that never opened the only unit.

features.name: Firmware target qualification
features.notes: Three filters, each failing closed. Filter 3 (still supported) is the binding one and has no data behind it, so it is asserted with evidence that must name something checkable - a date, a version or a host. db.check_identity_evidence alone was measured accepting 'Zyxel NWA50AX is supported', which is why the checkable-reference rule exists.

features.name: Statement coverage probe over audit_core
features.notes: sys.monitoring probe reporting which audit_core statements the suite never executes. Filters line 0 and multi-line signature continuations on both sides of the ratio. Only correct from a cold import graph, so the gate runs it as a subprocess.

features.name: Coverage allowlist gate
features.notes: Eighth gate. Every unexecuted statement must be listed with a reason; fails on an unlisted gap, a stale digest, and a listed line that now runs. Shells out to the probe CLI and checks pytest_rc. SKIPs below Python 3.12.

features.name: Mutation harness and gate
features.notes: AST mutation over temp copies of the tree, finding tests that execute a line while asserting nothing that depends on it. Opt-in: in GATES, in neither DEFAULT nor ALL_EXTRA, because ci.yml runs --all across three Python versions and the sweep takes about an hour. Run with make mutate.

features.name: Bounded, three-state ELF fact reader
features.notes: Pure stdlib ELF reader for architecture, linkage, dependencies and mitigations. Malformed offsets and partial tables return None or unknown facts rather than aborting a rootfs walk.

features.name: Firmware image provenance recorder
features.notes: Hashes and records a local target or diff-reference image. It never fetches, copies, carves, or alters firmware. Duplicate roles fail closed unless replace is explicit. A replacement changing the hash or version atomically clears only that image's triage manifest, requiring retriage before diff; Stage 4d also clears a changed target's dependent surface run, claims, unknowns, and old-unit surface coverage in that transaction.

features.name: Carved-rootfs inventory and evidenced boot services
features.notes: Turns an already-carved rootfs into file, ELF and boot-service rows. Empty and unacknowledged zero-ELF trees fail before any write; symlinks and nonregular entries are excluded; direct scandir traversal propagates scan, classification, and stat errors and rejects inconsistent directory classifications; regular files sort by relative path; prepared file, ELF, service, and coverage rows publish atomically. Failed fresh/retriage preserves all four publication tables. Acquired-target inventory uses db.firmware_unit_key while legacy-unscoped stays raw; retriage remains upsert-only. Ports remain agent-asserted and require evidence.

features.name: Image-scoped firmware manifests, durable comparison, and patch-analysis brief
features.notes: Last implementation commit is ea78e1b. Composite (image_id, path/name) keys preserve both images; the idempotent Stage 4b upgrade maps absent image IDs to legacy-unscoped and requires re-triage to populate manifests. Target-only inventory rule: target and compatible unscoped triage mirror cba_inventory; diff-reference triage never writes that coverage denominator. Stage 4d now qualifies acquired-target inventory and surface coverage keys; legacy-unscoped remains raw. Diff uses stored SHA-256 manifests and persists every changed path; content-addressed artifact installation precedes atomic SQL replacement. Changed acquired-image provenance clears the same-image manifest; read-side SQL errors are named. Triage upserts without pruning removed files, so refreshed carved trees require fresh scopes/runs. Agent analysis is patch-specific; surface mapping belongs to Stage 4d.

features.name: Exact-root firmware surface worklists, atomic results, completion gate, and agent brief
features.notes: Last implementation commit is b14b4fb; merged into local main at 6eba6d6, not pushed. Prepare verifies all target regular files by path/kind/size/SHA-256 and inventory agreement, rescans before publication, and writes canonical path-ordered batches (default 50, range 1..1000). Hints never reduce the complete target-manifest denominator. Strict 8 MiB results bind image/manifest/worklist/batch provenance and exactly one decision per unit; state unknowns require matching open settling questions, and analyzed no-surface units require a retained explanation or explanatory unknown. Canonical artifacts install before atomic batch-owned SQL; replace preserves sibling batches, import resets pending, and only check certifies complete with matching canonical evidence for every batch. Changed preparation/acquisition provenance invalidates dependent target state atomically; failures preserve prior SQL and may leave orphans. Expected SQL diagnostics are fixed; other expected diagnostics are escaped/capped at 512 ASCII characters plus newline; unexpected errors propagate after rollback. No audit, paid milestone benchmark, mutation sweep, or indicator snapshot ran; no fetch/carve/execute/hunt/severity/emulation/kernel/bootloader work or separate skill tree. Retained orphan-candidate scan scaling is a local-run performance limitation; future durable batch receipts should avoid it. db.firmware_unit_key qualifies acquired-target inventory and surface coverage units as /firmware/<image-ID Unicode character count>:<exact image ID>:<raw path>; legacy-unscoped remains raw. Generic coverage joins still match, and preparation/import/check/replacement/acquisition invalidation isolate overlapping targets. Manifests/worklists/results/surface and unknown component paths/human output remain raw. Old raw inventory is not accepted for acquired images; overlapping raw surface coverage refuses import even with replacement and is preserved by invalidation, requiring a fresh run when obstructed. ELF/service hints are image-scoped; globally keyed component hints remain advisory; triage is still upsert-only. New cross-image and encoding regressions are in tests/test_surface_gate.py. Stage 4e consumes the verified generation; the surface gate retains its orphan-candidate scan scaling limitation.

features.name: Stage 4f dedicated firmware review schema and row contracts
features.notes: Schema foundation only; the full Stage 4f phase remains in progress. Five additive tables retain image/generation/batch ownership for runs, receipts, verdicts, pivots and reviewed findings. Exact TableSpec contracts validate canonical unique JSON arrays, variant-specific evidence, bounded identifiers, lowercase digests, nonnegative counts, confidence 0-10, static-reviewed evidence rung, relative batch/component paths, and canonical stored paths. Phase modules must enforce run containment and cross-row ownership. No generic findings/verdicts or column migrations change. The verified completed-hunt snapshot, deterministic preparation and strict result parsing/validation are implemented; Task 6 atomic batch import is next, followed by completion, upstream invalidation wiring and CLI.

features.name: Read-only verified completed firmware hunt snapshot
features.notes: hunt.verified_snapshot shares the complete Stage 4e verifier with hunt.check, requires both lanes already complete and performs no SQL writes or status/timestamp transitions. Frozen lane/candidate/blocker records retain full candidate evidence and lane-qualified identity. Canonical artifact paths are verified run descendants and exposed run-relative. Supports read-only SQLite and caller-owned transactions; checks full denominators beyond the 200-row display cap and candidate-free lanes. Deterministic review preparation now consumes this helper; Stage 4f phase tables are not written by the helper itself.

features.name: Deterministic provenance-bound firmware review preparation
features.notes: Consumes the verified completed-hunt snapshot and exact live root. Canonical full-evidence candidate snapshots bind both hunt worklist digests and lane-qualified IDs with run-relative artifact provenance. Normalized priority-only similarity signatures never merge findings; equal signatures form deterministic indivisible clusters. Batch size is an integer from 1 to 200; clusters may exceed the target but clusters and emitted batches cannot exceed 1000. Empty hunts receive one empty batch. Immutable installation rejects symlink parents; locked revalidation repeats hunt/root/prior-run checks and installed-byte checks before pending-run publication. Index digest identifies the generation and binds batch policy. Same inputs preserve review state; changed preparation or explicit invalidation clears only the selected image's five review tables. Strict result parsing/validation is implemented; Task 6 atomic batch import is next. Completion, upstream invalidation wiring and CLI remain.

features.name: Strict read-only firmware review result parsing and validation
features.notes: Frozen typed records preserve exact reviewer evidence. Strict UTF-8 JSON rejects duplicate keys, extra/missing fields, coercions, non-finite values and invalid or mismatched verdict variants. Raw and canonical output each have an 8 MiB cap. Rules require canonical HE-1..18, PR-1..10, CV-1..3 or MARGINAL-GAIN. Validation reuses completed hunt lane/artifact verification, rebuilds current canonical review worklists, requires a matching run with consistent pending/complete status and completion timestamp, and enforces exact lane-qualified assignment membership before verdict semantics including confidence 0-10. Image IDs retain the existing nonempty UTF-8 text contract; candidate/pivot/root/surface IDs use bounded identifiers. Reviewed components and surfaces must belong to selected-image evidence; duplicate targets must be in-snapshot and non-self, with global chains deferred to Task 7. No SQL/artifact writes, live-root access, publication, completion or CLI; read-only SQLite and caller transactions supported. Task 6 artifact-first atomic batch import is next.

features.name: Evidence-bound two-lane firmware hunt, receipts, candidates, and agent brief
features.notes: Merged into local main at 8119af1, not pushed. Both lanes assign every selected target regular file exactly once and bind results to the current manifest and completed surface snapshot. Durable receipts own candidate-free batches; imports atomically publish receipt, image-qualified coverage, and candidates. not_applicable maps to analyzed coverage with its evidence-backed reason; budget skips fail the lane gate. Replacement is batch-scoped; changed acquisition, target triage, or surface evidence invalidates same-image hunts. Expected SQLite errors use the fixed hunt diagnostic; other expected errors are escaped/capped. Stage 4e remains firmware-audit functionality inside the shared codebase-audit repository, not a separately packaged skill. It inherits triage upsert-only snapshots and Stage 4d orphan-candidate scan scaling. Stage 4f firmware fpcheck has its schema foundation, verified completed-hunt snapshot, deterministic review preparation and strict result parsing/validation implemented; Task 6 atomic batch import is next. The Asus golden and monorepo/submodule decision remain overall Stage 4 prerequisites.

open_items.summary: The Stage 2 gate has never been run. Its document is a procedure, not a measurement.
open_items.note: A benchmark run now measures Stage 2 and Stage 3 together. That sequencing is the operator's call, not a defect in either document.

open_items.summary: The Stage 3 gate has never been run.
open_items.note: Requires two full tplink re-runs. Cost must fall and recall must stay at or above 9/19.

open_items.summary: No precision baseline exists on the current configuration, so the held Sonnet tiering change has no 'before' measurement.
open_items.note: This is why sonnet-tiering is held rather than shipped.

open_items.summary: install.ps1 has never been executed - there is no PowerShell on the development machine.
open_items.note: Its Bash sibling is covered by tests/test_install.py and the harness install gate. The PowerShell path is reviewed, not run.

open_items.summary: preflight output has never reached a client that actually connected a real MCP server.
open_items.note: The file is produced and its shape is tested; the end of the loop is unverified.

open_items.summary: chain --compose --replace and identify --replace still blank optional columns when their flags are omitted.
open_items.note: Real, pre-existing, parked with a ruling. The Stage 3 fix-wave report claimed otherwise; that claim is recorded as wrong so it is not trusted.

open_items.summary: Local main has not been pushed.
open_items.note: Previously closed after synchronization in Stage 3c. Rechecked 2026-10-16: git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...main reports 0 50 after post-merge reconciliation; local main includes the Stage 4d merge point 6eba6d6, with Stages 4c and 4d merged locally. Their former feature branches and worktrees have been removed. Nothing has been pushed.

open_items.summary: Nothing scores severity agreement, and nothing re-rates a finding once its chain is known. Of the nine reference CRITICALs the audit did find, four were rated below the reference - REF-17, a pre-auth authentication bypass, was filed LOW.
open_items.note: bench loads `severity` on both sides and compares neither. Recall therefore understates the problem: half the findings that were made were under-rated. Severity is a claim about reachability and consequence, and the pipeline fixes it at discovery time, before chain composition runs. Recorded at the end of Stage 0 as an input to later stages; never actioned.

open_items.summary: The Stage 4 gate requires the asus golden to pass, and no asus golden set exists.
open_items.note: Spec section 7: tplink >= 12/19 at <= $45 AND asus passing, the second target being the guard against overfitting. Building that golden set is the real first task of Stage 4, not a sub-step of it. tests/goldens/ currently holds one target.

open_items.summary: `--server NAME=COMMAND` silently overwrites a `--keep`-copied server of the same name with a bare {"command": ...}, discarding args and env.
open_items.note: Reproduced 2026-10-07: --from-config src.json --keep autorev --server autorev=uvx writes {"command": "uvx"} and exits 0, losing the args and env that made the server work. This is precisely the degradation load_servers' docstring says --keep exists to prevent. Untested in either direction.

open_items.summary: audit_core.briefs.render raises on missing placeholders and returns, so empty ones surface only on the next run.
open_items.note: Reproduced 2026-10-07: a template with one missing and one empty placeholder reports only the missing one; fixing it then reports the empty one. An operator fixing one class discovers the other a run later.

open_items.summary: workflows/fpcheck.md letters batches A, B, C while references/phase5-fp-check.md's worked example uses B1.
open_items.note: The artifact path pattern was unified in Stage 1; the identifiers themselves were not. Carried forward from Stage 1 and still present.

open_items.summary: Spec section 10: whether grey-audit joins the monorepo or consumes the core as a submodule is undecided.
open_items.note: The design assumes the monorepo; the submodule-plus-sync.sh fallback is specified in sections 3.1 and 8. The decision blocks the Stage 4 restructure, not the firmware phases.

open_items.summary: `qualify` is not discoverable by an operator: it appears in ARCHITECTURE.md, feature_lists.json and `audit.py --help` only.
open_items.note: SKILL.md is deliberately the WRONG home: it is codebase-audit's operating contract and this verb gates firmware audits, so listing it there would mislead an orchestrating model into thinking it is part of that pipeline. The right home is firmware-audit's own SKILL.md, which does not exist yet.
open_items.destination: the slice that creates firmware-audit's SKILL.md

open_items.summary: `load_scores` silently keeps the last row for a duplicate (vendor, model).
open_items.note: All 1,716 live keys are unique (verified), so this is latent: it bites only if the regenerated CSV ever gains a duplicate.

open_items.summary: The supported-case NO-GO footer is redundant and hedges.
open_items.note: It reads "...so findings pay zero. It pays zero and costs thousands..." and says "either the operator declared it unsupported or the support claim is not checkable" although the filter line directly above states which.

open_items.summary: Filter 3 is not a gate against an operator who wants a GO.
open_items.note: It blocks absent and lazy assertions and forces the claim into the output where a later reader can falsify it, but any 20+ character string containing a year and one novel token passes (e.g. "it is not supported anymore as of 2020"). Recorded as a known property of the rule, not a bug.

open_items.summary: The test row for a negative rce_cves uses a Unicode minus, so int() rejects it before the `rce_cves < 0` branch runs; that branch is therefore not exercised.
open_items.note: Found by the Stage 4a whole-branch re-review. The branch itself is present and correct - only its test coverage is illusory. Same class as the Task 2 test that substituted an easier input for the one its finding named.

open_items.summary: The coverage and mutate gates measure audit_core only (harness.py passes --package audit_core), so coverage_probe.py, coverage_allowlist.py, mutate.py, mutation-verify.py and gate_coverage's own failure branches are unmeasured by the tools they implement.
open_items.note: Seven hollow tests were caught during Stage 3c and several were in the instruments themselves. Found by the Stage 3c whole-branch review; widening the gates was judged a stage of work, so it is recorded rather than done.

open_items.summary: cba_binfacts and cba_services use root-relative path or service name as their primary key, so triaging two carved images into one run can overwrite rows from the first image.
open_items.note: Closed by Stage 4c composite firmware keys and an atomic, idempotent Stage 4b rebuild. The additional cba_inventory.unit collision is prevented by target-only inventory mirroring: diff-reference triage does not write target coverage inventory.

open_items.summary: Surface completion scans retained orphan result generations to find canonical evidence for claim-free batches; runtime grows with retained candidates.
open_items.note: Accepted by the Stage 4d pre-documentation whole-branch review as a local-run performance limitation. Each result remains bounded; no arbitrary cap may weaken the full-denominator gate. A future durable batch receipt should remove the discovery scan.
